name: signoff
description: DevOps/developer/tester subagent team, guardrail hooks, and a project bootstrap skill - every stage requires a real, tested signoff before the next one starts. One install per new project, configured with a few parameters instead of copy-pasted files.

project_slug.title: Project slug
project_slug.description: Short project identifier used in resource tags and branch names (e.g. 'client-x-poc').

cloud_hint.title: Cloud provider/region hint (optional)
cloud_hint.description: Leave blank in almost every case. cloud-engineer determines the provider and region during feasibility analysis and records it in docs/cost-estimate.md - that's the actual source of truth downstream agents read. Only set this if you already know for certain (e.g. a client contractually requires AWS in a specific region) and want cloud-engineer to treat it as a fixed constraint rather than something to evaluate.

guardrail_level.title: Guardrail level
guardrail_level.description: 'standard' or 'strict'. Strict raises the bar the developer and tester subagents hold work to (e.g. required test coverage, mandatory rollback docs).

frontend_stack.title: Frontend stack
frontend_stack.description: Framework the frontend-developer subagent should default to (e.g. 'react', 'vue').

backend_stack.title: Backend stack
backend_stack.description: Framework the backend-developer subagent should default to.

gitlab_token.title: GitLab access token
gitlab_token.description: Project or personal access token used by the bundled GitLab MCP server. Set this at install time — never paste it into a file.
